## About
Being in a collision is scary. You're shaken up, your car is damaged, and you don't know who to trust. Our shop in Phoenix helps you get your car back on the road looking the way it did before the accident.
Our owner, Israel, has spent years in this business in this area and has passed what he knows down to our technicians. Customers often deal with him directly. One reviewer said he finished the job much sooner than other shops estimated, one called his price honest, and another called the shop affordable.
We're rated 5 on Google from 86 reviews. Give us a call or stop by with any questions, and we'll help you get started.

## Services
- Body repair: Dents, scratches, missing pieces and damage all around the car. One reviewer said Israel addressed every spot at an honest price.
- Auto painting: We paint in our own water painting booth so new parts match your original paint. One customer brought in a bumper to be color matched.
- Frame damage: Frame damage can be serious if it isn't handled right. We check the frame to make sure your car is safe to drive, and if there's damage, we make a plan to fix it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you really pay my deductible?
A: Yes. We pay your deductible so you have one less cost to worry about after an accident.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all insurance companies, whether the claim is through your insurer or the other driver's.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. Give us a call if you have questions about other times.
